purpose: Execute present WP5 controls with an explicit, changing technical subject; preserve frozen historical evidence without transferring its approval.

connector_fingerprint.algorithm: Existing SHA256 of sorted connector-relative path, NUL, exact file bytes, NUL; unchanged exclusions for node_modules and manifests/package-manifest.json.
connector_fingerprint.interpretation: Historical fingerprint remains historical. Current connector fingerprint is measured anew and is not an approval or a persistent PASS receipt.

excluded_subtrees: node_modules directories only, separately handled as actual loaded dependency modules
repository_inventory.notes: The larger current inventory includes connector package-manifest bytes even though the unchanged historical connector-fingerprint algorithm excludes that exact file. All16 successor package files are source or historical/policy data, including the pin manifest and policy; no generated execution receipt is persisted there. Task capsules and scratch emitted results are not recursively included.
repository_inventory.path_rules: Resolve roots from the verifier's own repository location. Required roots/files must exist. Unique sorted POSIX relative paths using byte-stable UTF8 order; reject traversal, absolute entries, symlink components, special files and out-of-repository real paths. No silent skips except named node_modules handling.
repository_inventory.preparation_measurement: Independent read-only baseline scan: proposed existing roots253 tracked files/3568580bytes, largest1062135, depth6; actual final subject must be independently measured and can differ.

executed_module_coverage.mechanism_candidate: Fresh control child processes preload a Node synchronous registerHooks guard before loading control/application modules. Record every actual loaded repository and dependency module; require repository modules in the bounded inventory. Built-in Node modules are identified separately. Require loaded package dependencies to resolve inside this task-owned node_modules and record actual module bytes plus package metadata and lock binding. Reject unsupported schemes, out-of-root modules, uncovered repository modules and unsupported native addons. No regex-import closure as authority.
executed_module_coverage.remaining_feasibility: Prove synchronous ESM/CJS/JSON coverage and test-process inheritance on actual connector controls; choose an explicit bounded installed-package mapping. The guard is semantic input accounting, not a sandbox or security acceptance claim. Preserve source bytes and execution behavior; no transform/rebinding in final verification.

execution.controls: Run all discovered current connector tests, require all five original files and their retained mandatory case names, and reject missing/skipped/todo/cancelled/failed mandatory controls. Execute current fixture matrix, delivery waves, legacy parity and request/capture reconciliation and compare actual outcomes with preserved policy expectations. Execute actual R2/security/strict-contract/cursor/304 controls; historical R2 and zero-payload booleans cannot replace current execution.
execution.test_protocol: Use bounded fresh child process commands and structured native test events or strictly validated retained TAP with nonzero leaf counts, original required cases, exit/signal/deadline/output bounds and actual source/subject checks before and after. Root runner remains unchanged and selects latest complete WP5 package. Current package test and validate entrypoints both enforce the complete applicable controls without mutating sealed artifacts.
execution.results: Generated current outcomes and manifests are emitted to stdout or task-owned scratch outside all sealed package/source roots. No historical PASS file is restamped.
execution.subject_drift: Recompute source/dependency inventories after execution and reject mid-run changes; a later legitimate source change produces a distinct unapproved subject requiring new root review/gate/CI.

subject.canonical_basis: ushso-canonical-json.v1; deterministic manifest of policy/version, current connector fingerprint, bounded file hash/length records, actual loaded module records, runtime Node version/process.versions/platform/arch and lock/configured packageManager. Current test/result identity is bound separately without self-referential persistent receipt.
subject.npm_observation: Distinguish configured packageManager from actual installer/command npm evidence. Do not mislabel ambient npm11.9 as committed npm11.19.1 or use an unauthenticated environment string as toolchain proof. Exact gate retains actual installer/toolchain evidence; direct Node verification must report any unobserved npm execution honestly. Final design of this observation remains under review.
subject.origin: After focusedPR010 component acceptance, retain actualM010 commit/tree/source+fixture pins as immutable origin provenance. This is distinct from current source identity; future source cannot impersonate origin or reuse its approval. All origin merge identities remain null until observed.

negative_cases: Missing/altered frozen historical file or pin; relabeled historical PASS.
Changed connector, nonconnector runtime dependency, schema, fixture, policy, verifier/test, installed loaded dependency, runtime or lock changes current subject; old subject receipt rejects.
Unsupported/symlink/out-of-root import or file, incomplete root inventory, missing required file, duplicate manifest entry, file/depth/count/byte bound.
Empty/removed/skipped mandatory test, copied prior results, missing terminal event, process failure/signal/deadline/output truncation, mid-run source change.
Strict query-bearing public reference, wrong final cursor, missing304 lineage or same-ID conflicting old capture bytes.
Historical approval on current subject, current approval issuance or external activation overclaim.
